prompt: We played cards at my uncle's flat last night. My cousin (tell) us not to hide our aces, yet my brother kept slipping one under his mug. “I'm playing fair!” he (say). Nobody trusted him: his nervous grin (speak) volumes, so he finally had to say sorry to the whole table.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске нужен глагол tell (told us not to hide — косвенная просьба с дополнением), во втором — said для прямой речи без адресата, в третьем — устойчивое выражение speak volumes (говорить само за себя).

prompt: Our band rehearsed in a basement studio last evening. The sound engineer (tell) the bassist to turn down his amplifier. “The vocals are completely buried,” he (say). I then asked our lead singer to (speak) up during the bridge before the drums kicked back in.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используем told + дополнение + инфинитив (told the bassist to turn down), во втором — said после прямой речи, в третьем — фразовый глагол speak up (говорить громче).

prompt: I am heading to the train station now, so you can (tell) me the gate number once you check the board. My phone battery is almost dead, and the conductor just (say) that our platform might change. Please (speak) clearly if you leave a voice note.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске ставим tell, так как сразу следует адресат (tell me); во втором — said перед придаточным с that без указания слушателя; в третьем — speak для характеристики манеры речи.

prompt: We planned a secret farewell dinner for Leo last Friday. His neighbour had to (talk) him into staying at the gym while we hung the banners. When Leo walked in, he froze and didn't (say) a word for ten seconds before he (tell) us how touched he was.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске используется фразовый глагол talk someone into (уговорить кого-либо), во втором — устойчивое выражение not say a word (не проронить ни слова), в третьем — told перед косвенным дополнением us.

prompt: During yesterday's trivia night, our team hesitated over a geography clue. I (tell) my partners that the capital was Tallinn. “Are you positive?” Mia (say). Fortunately, our teammate can (speak) Estonian and verified my guess right before the buzzer sounded.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске нужен глагол told, так как указан адресат (my partners); во втором — said при прямой речи; в третьем — speak с названием языка (speak Estonian).

prompt: Two commuters were (talk) politics on the platform while waiting for the delayed express train. One passenger (say) that fuel taxes were rising too fast. The station announcer then (tell) everyone to stand behind the yellow line as the train approached.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске употребляется устойчивое сочетание talk politics (обсуждать политику) в форме Continuous; во втором — said перед придаточным с that; в третьем — конструкция told everyone to stand.

prompt: The drama coach chose me to introduce the winter play on stage. My throat was so dry that I could barely (speak). My co-host whispered that the audience in the balcony couldn't hear me. “Just (say) your lines calmly,” she urged, and afterwards the coach (tell) us we had sounded confident.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске speak обозначает физическую способность говорить; во втором — say перед прямым дополнением (your lines); в третьем — told с обязательным адресатом us.

prompt: Last semester, our university welcomed a visiting researcher from Oslo. She can (speak / talk) four languages fluently and is currently studying Japanese. During a seminar, she (said / told) us about her field work in the Arctic. “The winter nights last almost all day,” she (said / told), displaying photos of the northern lights.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске с языками используется глагол speak. Во втором — told, так как есть прямое дополнение (us) и предлог about. В третьем для передачи прямой речи без указания адресата выбираем said.

prompt: “Put the box inside the porch,” I (say) to the delivery driver on Tuesday morning. He nodded and (tell) me that a signature wasn't required. We briefly (talk) about the heavy rain before he hurried back to his van.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске глагол say требует предлога to перед адресатом (said to the delivery driver); во втором — told употребляется без предлога перед me; в третьем — talked about (поговорили о погоде).

prompt: During yesterday's gallery tour, the curator (tell) us a fascinating story about a stolen sketch. “A cleaner found it behind a radiator,” she (say). Because she could (speak) Portuguese, she also read out a handwritten note glued to the back of the frame.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске устойчивое сочетание tell a story (рассказать историю); во втором — said при прямой речи; в третьем — speak с названием языка (speak Portuguese).

prompt: Lucas is (say) to be the most inventive pastry chef in the district. Yesterday he (tell) food bloggers that he uses wild honey in every tart. “Fresh ingredients make all the difference,” he (say) during the tasting event.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске страдательная конструкция is said to be (говорят, что он является); во втором — told с указанием адресата (food bloggers); в третьем — said для прямой речи.

prompt: At Tuesday's town hall session, the moderator (tell) citizens to submit their proposals in writing. “We want realistic budgets,” he (say). One resident stood up to (speak) up for cyclists who needed safer lanes along the riverfront.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске конструкция told + дополнение + инфинитив (told citizens to submit); во втором — said после прямой речи; в третьем — фразовый глагол speak up for (выступить в защиту).

prompt: To (say) the least, the ferry crossing in the storm was exhausting. The captain (tell) passengers to stay inside the lounge until we reached the harbour. Nobody (talk) much until the boat finally docked safely.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске вводный оборот to say the least (мягко говоря); во втором — told passengers to stay; в третьем — talked в значении «разговаривать».

prompt: Yesterday our community drama club unpacked rented outfits. The stage manager (tell) us not to cut off the tags. “They belong to the city theatre,” she (say). Frankly (speak), the velvet coat I got smelled dusty, yet it suited my role.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске told us not to cut (просьба с отрицанием); во втором — said при прямой речи; в третьем — вводное выражение frankly speaking (откровенно говоря).

prompt: Looking at these two contracts, I honestly can't (tell) a real ink signature from a laser print. The legal clerk (say) that both documents arrived in the same envelope. We need to (speak) with the manager before filing them.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске глагол tell в значении «отличить» (tell X from Y); во втором — said перед придаточным с that; в третьем — speak with someone (поговорить с кем-либо).

prompt: Needless to (say), we were thrilled when the airline located our missing suitcases. The baggage clerk (tell) us that the bags had been put on a later flight by mistake. We thanked her and (talk) about how smooth the rest of the trip had been.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске устойчивый оборот needless to say (само собой разумеется); во втором — told us that (сообщила нам); в третьем — talked about (поговорили о чём-либо).

prompt: My optician (tell) me yesterday that my eyesight hadn't changed at all. “You don't need new lenses yet,” she (say) with a smile. Still, we (talk) for ten minutes about reducing screen glare at work.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске told me (указан адресат); во втором — said для прямой речи; в третьем — talked в значении «беседовали».

prompt: That awkward pause during the meeting (speak) volumes about how worried the staff are. Nobody wanted to (say) anything negative in front of the director. Afterward, two engineers (tell) me they were already updating their resumes.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске идиома speak volumes (быть очень показательным); во втором — say anything (сказать что-либо, без адресата); в третьем — told me (с адресатом).

prompt: You really ought to (speak) your mind before the committee votes on the schedule. If you stay quiet now, you can't (say) later that nobody listened. Yesterday Claire (tell) the chair directly why the deadline was unrealistic.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске устойчивое выражение speak your mind (открыто высказать своё мнение); во втором — say that (без адресата); в третьем — told the chair (с адресатом).

prompt: Has the tour operator (tell) you about the museum entry fee yet? Their brochure (say) that all excursions were included in the package. I tried to (talk) to an agent online this morning, but the chat was offline.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске told you (Present Perfect, есть адресат you); во втором — said/says (в брошюре говорится); в третьем — talk to someone (поговорить с кем-либо).

prompt: Even with good headphones, it's hard to (tell) the difference between these two audio files. The producer (say) that one track was recorded in a hallway. Let's (talk) over the sound settings before we export the final episode.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске устойчивое словосочетание tell the difference (увидеть разницу); во втором — said перед придаточным с that; в третьем — фразовый глагол talk over (обсудить).

prompt: I baked a lemon cake yesterday, but the batter looked lumpy. The box (say) “Sift the flour first”, which I had ignored. My flatmate (tell) me off for skipping steps, then (talk) me through making a fresh glaze so dessert wasn't ruined.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске said используется для передачи письменной инструкции на коробке; во втором — фразовый глагол tell someone off (отчитать); в третьем — talk someone through (подробно объяснить процесс).

prompt: The airline lost my suitcase when I landed in Rome yesterday. Luckily, I can (speak / talk) Italian, so I walked straight to the baggage desk. The agent (said / told) me that my bag had arrived on a later flight. “We will deliver it to your hotel tonight,” he (said / told), handing me a tracking receipt.
explanation_ru: Для владения иностранным языком используется speak. Во втором пропуске нужен глагол told, так как сразу за ним идёт дополнение me. В третьем при цитировании прямой речи без адресата употребляется said.

prompt: At the bookshop yesterday, a tourist asked whether I could ___ Polish, and luckily my coworker stepped in to help him find the travel guides.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения владения иностранным языком (speak Polish) используется только глагол speak.

prompt: During our first woodworking workshop, the instructor ___ us through sanding the wooden frame smoothly before applying any varnish.
explanation_ru: Фразовый глагол talk someone through something означает «подробно объяснить кому-либо, как выполнить задачу шаг за шагом».

prompt: At Saturday's flea market, I spotted two almost identical vintage watches and couldn't ___ them apart until the dealer pointed out the engravings.
explanation_ru: Устойчивое выражение tell them apart означает «отличить одно от другого».

prompt: My brother practised his graduation toast at home last night, and frankly ___, the jokes about our childhood were a bit too embarrassing.
explanation_ru: Вводное устойчивое выражение frankly speaking переводится как «откровенно говоря».

prompt: We boarded the wrong tram yesterday because the map looked confusing, so the inspector ___ us to get off at the next square.
explanation_ru: Для передачи совета или указания с дополнением и инфинитивом используется модель tell + someone + to do something.

prompt: At yesterday's tennis club, a senior member told me how to adjust my grip while people nearby were saying football.
answer: At yesterday's tennis club, a senior member told me how to adjust my grip while people nearby were talking football.
accepted_answers: At yesterday's tennis club, a senior member told me how to adjust my grip while people nearby were talking football.
At yesterday's tennis club, a senior member told me how to adjust my grip while people nearby were talking about football.
explanation_ru: Ошибка в глаголе saying: для обсуждения темы используется устойчивое сочетание talk football (или talk about football), а не say football.

prompt: Yesterday I helped my grandfather update his phone, told him not to click strange links, and talked him through sending a photo.
answer: Yesterday I helped my grandfather update his phone, told him not to click strange links, and talked him through sending a photo.
accepted_answers: Yesterday I helped my grandfather update his phone, told him not to click strange links, and talked him through sending a photo.
explanation_ru: Ошибок нет: конструкция told him not to click и фразовый глагол talked him through употреблены грамматически верно.

prompt: At the airport yesterday, a traveller couldn't read the self-check screen, so I offered help because I can tell Spanish.
answer: At the airport yesterday, a traveller couldn't read the self-check screen, so I offered help because I can speak Spanish.
accepted_answers: At the airport yesterday, a traveller couldn't read the self-check screen, so I offered help because I can speak Spanish.
explanation_ru: Ошибка в глаголе tell: с названиями языков для обозначения владения ими используется глагол speak (speak Spanish).

prompt: The bakery had a fresh specials board yesterday, and our waiter told us that the apple tart had just sold out.
answer: The bakery had a fresh specials board yesterday, and our waiter told us that the apple tart had just sold out.
accepted_answers: The bakery had a fresh specials board yesterday, and our waiter told us that the apple tart had just sold out.
explanation_ru: Ошибок нет: глагол told правильно употреблён перед косвенным дополнением us и придаточным предложением с that.

prompt: I helped out at a bookshop yesterday, where a customer said me that he needed a dictionary for his evening class.
answer: I helped out at a bookshop yesterday, where a customer told me that he needed a dictionary for his evening class.
accepted_answers: I helped out at a bookshop yesterday, where a customer told me that he needed a dictionary for his evening class.
I helped out at a bookshop yesterday, where a customer said to me that he needed a dictionary for his evening class.
explanation_ru: Ошибка в управлении глагола: после say нельзя ставить прямое дополнение me без предлога to; правильно использовать told me (или said to me).
